subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The votive offering rested on a carved **mensa**.

options.text: The mason lifted the mensa into place beneath the arch.
The altar's mensa was covered in embroidered linen.
The bishop prayed before the marble mensa.
The relics were sealed beneath the mensa.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mensa"** refers to a table or flat surface, often used in the context of an altar in religious settings. (मेज़ या वेदी का सपाट भाग)
 
 
• **Example:** The altar's mensa was adorned with flowers and candles during the ceremony.
 
 
• As a homonym, "mensa" can also refer to a physical table or flat structure in a secular context, such as construction or architecture. (मेज़ या सपाट संरचना)
 
 
• **Example:** The mason lifted the mensa into place beneath the arch.
 
 
• Hence, the sentence in Option 1 contains the homonym of the highlighted word "mensa." It uses "mensa" in a secular architectural context, differing from the religious meaning used in the statement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** The altar's mensa was covered in embroidered linen. (वेदी का मेज़ कढ़ाई वाले लिनन से ढका हुआ था)
 
 
• **Explanation:** This sentence uses "mensa" in its religious context, referring to the flat surface of the altar, and does not provide a homonym.
 
 
• **Option 3:** The bishop prayed before the marble mensa. (बिशप संगमरमर की वेदी के सामने प्रार्थना कर रहे थे)
 
 
• **Explanation:** This sentence also uses "mensa" in its religious context and does not present a homonym.
 
 
• **Option 4:** The relics were sealed beneath the mensa. (अवशेषों को वेदी के नीचे सील कर दिया गया)
 
 
• **Explanation:** Again, "mensa" is used in the religious context of an altar and does not contain a homonym.
 

5d:Td0f,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
